meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 pandas/NumPy 工作流扩展到集群或超内存数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果现有 pandas 代码因内存不足或数据量过大而无法运行
copy.tagline_en: Scale pandas/NumPy workflows to clusters or out-of-core data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your existing pandas code fails due to memory or data size limits

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Dask 库处理超过内存大小的数据，比如并行读取多个 CSV 文件、进行分组聚合等操作，结果在调用 .compute() 时返回。
howto.when: 当你需要处理的数据量超过可用内存，或者想加速 pandas/NumPy 操作时，可以要求 Claude 使用 Dask。

say.text: 用 Dask 读取 data/2024-*.csv 并计算每类平均值。
帮我用 Dask 并行处理 logs 文件夹里的 JSON 文件。
say.note: Claude 会使用 dask.bag 进行流式处理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Dask to process datasets larger than RAM, e.g., parallel reading of multiple CSV files and groupby aggregations, with results returned upon calling .compute().
howto.when_en: When you need to process data exceeding available memory or accelerate pandas/NumPy operations, you can ask Claude to use Dask.

say_en.text: Use Dask to read data/2024-*.csv and compute mean per category.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Dask DataFrame code and execute it.

say_en.text: Help me process JSON files in logs folder in parallel with Dask.
say_en.note: Claude will use dask.bag for streaming processing.
